responsibility: Implements the core generic Darwin/Mach-O target backend support shared across frontends and architectures. It owns Darwin section objects and section-switching logic, Mach-O-specific constructor/destructor handling, symbol and visibility-related target behavior, Fix-and-Continue support state, Objective-C section ordering, deployment-version-sensitive codegen flags, and CFString constant pooling/building routines that construct anonymous Mach-O data objects for Objective-C/CoreFoundation literals. It also provides Darwin function-section selection and other assembler/object emission helpers that realize the policy declared in darwin.h.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the Darwin same-name group: it provides the out-of-line Mach-O/Darwin backend behavior such as section handling, constructor/destructor emission, Fix-and-Continue support, CFString construction, and function-section selection, whereas gcc/config/darwin.h declares the target macros/specs and hook bindings and gcc/config/darwin.opt only describes Darwin command-line options.
